newsitem.title: USA: Live to be acquired by investor group.
newsitem.headline: Live to be acquired by investor group.

text.p: Live Entertainment Inc., a movie distributor, said Friday it agreed to be acquired by an investor group led by Richland, Gordon & Co.
The company said its board of directors as well as Pioneer Electronic Corp., the holder of about 50.3 percent of the company's outstanding voting power, had agreed to the deal.
Holders of Live's series B preferred stock will receive $10 per share in cash, plus accrued dividends, and holders of its common stock will receive $6 per share in cash.
Live's stock was unchanged at $5.625 early on Nasdaq.
The Los Angeles-based company said its outstanding debt will also be redeemed at par plus accrued interest.
The company said the deal requires financing under commitment letters aggregating $150 million delivered by the investor group.
The company said the deal is also subject to approvals at a special shareholders meeting expected to be held in June.
